points.S1: 气瓶和瓶阀的法规要求

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排用链条固定的气瓶旁，手指着瓶顶的阀门，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a row of gas cylinders chained to the wall, points at the brass valve on top of one cylinder, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲气瓶阀的安全使用。

shots.scene: 慢转箭头、瓶帽、链条、扳手打叉四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a slow turning arrow, a cylinder cap, a wall chain, and a wrench crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 慢开关、戴瓶帽、固定好、不自修。

shots.scene: 阿杰一手抓着瓶阀，拖着一只没有瓶帽的气瓶在地上走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student drags an uncapped gas cylinder across the floor by gripping its valve with one hand.
shots.narration: 阿杰抓着瓶阀，拖着气瓶就走。

shots.scene: 气瓶倒地、瓶阀断裂喷气的示意图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cylinder falling over with its valve snapping off and gas jetting out, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶阀一旦撞断，气瓶会像炮弹一样冲出。

shots.scene: 老李推来气瓶推车，示意阿杰停下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer rolls over a cylinder hand truck and signals the young male student to stop.
shots.narration: 老李赶紧拦住：先戴瓶帽，用推车！

shots.section_title: 气瓶阀是关键安全部件
shots.scene: 气瓶顶部的瓶阀特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a brass cylinder valve on top of a gas cylinder with a small handwheel and an outlet. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶阀管着瓶里的高压气体进出。
overlay: 气瓶阀是关键安全部件

shots.section_title: 气瓶阀是关键安全部件
shots.scene: 流水线上的瓶阀逐个通过测试台，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Cylinder valves pass one by one through a test station on a production line, each getting a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 出厂前，每只瓶阀都要测试。

shots.scene: 瓶阀剖面示意：阀体、阀杆、密封件
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a cylinder valve showing the body, the stem and the seal. No people.
shots.narration: 结构规范统一，才能装得对。

shots.scene: 密封良好的阀门打勾，漏气冒泡的阀门打叉
shots.prompt_en: A tight valve with a green check next to a valve with leak bubbles crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 装得对，泄漏就少。

shots.section_title: 装配只能由专业单位做
shots.scene: 三个零件按顺序组装成一只瓶阀的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of three valve parts assembled in order into one complete cylinder valve. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶阀由几个部件按工序装配。
overlay: 装配只能由专业单位做

shots.section_title: 装配只能由专业单位做
shots.scene: 专业工厂里的装配台，旁边空白资质证书
shots.prompt_en: An assembly bench in a professional facility with a blank qualification certificate on the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 装配和维修，只能由专业单位进行。

shots.section_title: 装配只能由专业单位做
shots.scene: 学生拿扳手拆瓶阀的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student using a wrench to take apart a cylinder valve, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里，任何人都不要拆瓶阀。

shots.scene: 瓶阀旁边一本空白标准手册和打勾印章
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder valve next to a blank standards booklet and a green check stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶阀的设计和性能，要符合标准。

shots.scene: 测试台上的扭力装置把瓶阀关紧，指示灯变绿
shots.prompt_en: A test rig with a torque tool closing a valve, a green indicator light turning on. No people.
shots.narration: 出厂要确认关闭可靠。

shots.scene: 关好的瓶阀在搬运中没有被碰开
shots.prompt_en: A closed cylinder valve protected inside a cap on a cylinder being moved, with a lock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 防止阀门被意外打开。

shots.scene: 老周和阿杰核对空白采购单
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the young male student check a blank purchase form together.
shots.narration: 气瓶由有资质的单位供应和充装。

shots.section_title: 气瓶和瓶阀的法规要求
shots.scene: 王老师在空白屏幕前讲解，屏幕上是气瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains in front of a blank screen showing a gas cylinder icon.
shots.narration: 气瓶和瓶阀按特种设备规定管理。
overlay: 气瓶和瓶阀的法规要求

shots.section_title: 气瓶和瓶阀的法规要求
shots.scene: 不同颜色的气瓶并排，瓶肩挂着空白检验标签
shots.prompt_en: Several gas cylinders of different body colors, each with a blank inspection tag on the shoulder. No people.
shots.narration: 看颜色认气体，看标签查检验期。

shots.section_title: 气瓶和瓶阀的法规要求
shots.scene: 压力表指针接近零，旁边红色警示
shots.prompt_en: A blank cylinder gauge needle approaching zero with a small red warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用气要留余压，不要用尽。

shots.scene: 小研站在气瓶侧面，用手慢慢打开瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands to the side of the cylinder and slowly opens the valve by hand.
shots.narration: 开瓶阀要慢，人站在侧面。

shots.scene: 用扳手加力、锤子敲瓶阀的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a wrench forcing a cylinder valve and a hammer striking it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只用手开关，不得加力或敲打。

shots.scene: 小研用完关紧瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the cylinder valve firmly by hand after finishing her work.
shots.narration: 用完、空瓶都要关紧瓶阀。

shots.scene: 氧气瓶阀旁的油手套图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen cylinder valve icon next to an oily glove, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气瓶阀严禁沾油脂。

shots.scene: 老李给气瓶拧上瓶帽
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer screws a protective cap onto a cylinder over its valve.
shots.narration: 搬运前，先关阀，再戴好瓶帽。

shots.scene: 老李用专用推车运送固定好的气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer moves a capped cylinder strapped to a two-wheel cylinder hand truck.
shots.narration: 用专用推车，绑好再走。

shots.scene: 滚气瓶、拖气瓶、手提瓶阀三个图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: rolling a cylinder on its side, dragging a cylinder, and lifting it by the valve, all crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不滚、不拖、不抛，不手提瓶阀。

shots.scene: 气瓶直立，用链条固定在墙上
shots.prompt_en: Gas cylinders stand upright, secured with chains to a wall bracket. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶要直立固定，防止倾倒。

shots.scene: 气瓶远离暖气和明火的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a cylinder placed well away from a heater and an open flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 远离热源、明火，放在通风处。

shots.scene: 瓶阀处冒出检漏泡泡
shots.prompt_en: Leak detection bubbles forming around a cylinder valve stem. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶阀漏气、开关困难，不要自己修。

shots.scene: 扳手拧瓶阀阀杆的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wrench tightening a cylinder valve stem nut on a full cylinder, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不得自行拧阀杆，不得带压拆卸。

shots.scene: 老李在气瓶上挂空白停用牌，打电话
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hangs a blank out-of-service tag on the cylinder and makes a phone call.
shots.narration: 挂牌停用，通知供气单位处理。

shots.scene: 气瓶阀口嘶嘶漏气，小研能安全关阀时关闭瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: Gas hisses from a cylinder valve; the female graduate student closes the valve while standing to the side.
shots.narration: 漏气时，能安全关阀就先关阀。

shots.scene: 开窗通风，电灯开关和火焰图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an open window and fan, next to a light switch and a flame crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 通风，可燃气体不碰电器明火。

shots.scene: 小研带阿杰撤到走廊，向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads the young male student into the corridor and reports to the older man.
shots.narration: 人员撤离，报告实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有火焰和红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a fire icon and a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 火情拨打119，有人受伤拨打120。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现瓶阀、检验标签和颜色气瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a cylinder valve, an inspection tag and colored cylinders.
shots.narration: 瓶阀专业装，气瓶查颜色和检验期。

shots.scene: 侧站慢开、瓶帽推车、链条固定三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a person opening a valve from the side, a capped cylinder on a hand truck, a chained cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 侧身慢开，戴帽推车，直立固定。

shots.scene: 停用牌、出口、电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an out-of-service tag, an exit door and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 漏气不自修，挂牌报告，撤离求援。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐固定的气瓶架前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a tidy rack of capped, chained gas cylinders.
shots.narration: 管好小瓶阀，守住大安全，下次见！
